name: Approval Agents
tagline: agent pipeline that routes vendor approvals through human review
summary: A production agent system that reads vendor emails and attachments, matches them to approval records, and sends every action through human review.
sourceNote: Built at Wisflux. The source is private.

highlights.text: eight-phase pipeline from triage to a human-approved commit
43 read-only MCP tools, scoped per phase
Gmail, Outlook and IMAP ingestion with encrypted storage
React review desk graded by model confidence
nightly replay of real cases and a tool-parity gate

name: Pay Bot
tagline: chat and voice agent that fills payment forms for approval
summary: A conversational agent that turns a typed or spoken request into a validated payment form that a person submits for approval. It runs on a 4B local model on a 6 GB GPU.
sourceNote: Freelance client work. The source is private.

highlights.text: rule engine as the source of truth, with the model limited to proposing values
median turn cut from 16.9 s to about 2 s by making one model call where there were three
form-generic packages, so a new form is configuration, not code
speech in and out with faster-whisper and Piper
evals on the real API, plus mutation testing

name: Agent Manager
tagline: desktop app that runs coding agents in parallel worktrees
summary: A native desktop app in Rust that runs several coding agents at once, each in its own git worktree, with live output and steering.

highlights.text: process supervisor running agents in parallel, one worktree each
NDJSON stream parser feeding a live transcript
send new instructions to an agent mid-session, or interrupt it
112 tests against a fake agent binary

name: Session Memory
tagline: memory layer that files and recalls coding-agent sessions
summary: Memory for coding-agent sessions: hooks file each session into a notes vault by project, a small model tags and summarizes it, and the next session starts with that context.
sourceNote: Personal project, built on the open-source mempalace tool. Not public yet.

highlights.text: hooks on session start, stop and compaction that never block a session
file each turn under the right project, even when the session moved
tag every turn and write a summary with decisions and follow-ups
command-line search by keyword, topic, file, date and project

name: Markup Check
tagline: vision pipeline that verifies reviewer markups across PDF revisions
summary: A vision pipeline that finds reviewer markups on engineering PDFs and checks whether the next revision addressed them.
sourceNote: Built at Wisflux. The source is private.

highlights.text: YOLO markup detector trained on synthetic pages on a SLURM GPU cluster
page matching across revisions with text, embeddings and perceptual hashes
a verdict for each comment from GPT-4o, with a confidence
review app with live progress over SSE

name: Issue to PR
tagline: design for a coding agent that takes an issue to a pull request
summary: A coding agent that reads a GitHub issue, reproduces it with a failing test, fixes the code in a sandbox, and opens a pull request with its evidence. Every tool is reached over MCP.

highlights.text: repository, shell and test tools exposed as MCP servers
locate, reproduce, fix, verify, with three attempts at most
resolve rate on SWE-bench Verified tasks and my own issue set

name: Deep Research
tagline: design for a supervisor agent that writes cited reports
summary: A supervisor agent that plans a question, sends searchers out in parallel, and writes a report in which every claim is checked against the passage it cites.

highlights.text: planner, parallel searchers, writer and checker passing typed state
every sentence in the report tied to a stored passage
citation precision and coverage on a fixed question set

name: Trajectory Gate
tagline: design for a CI gate that replays agent tool calls
summary: A check on every pull request that replays recorded agent runs and blocks the merge when the sequence of tool calls drifts from the approved one.

highlights.text: record every run as an ordered list of tool calls
replay approved runs offline against the new build
fail the check when a run skips, adds or reorders a step

name: Agent Tracer
tagline: design for agent tracing with a budget guard
summary: OpenTelemetry spans for every model call and tool call, with cost on each one, and a guard that stops a runaway run or moves it to a cheaper model.

highlights.text: a span per call with tokens, latency and cost
stop, downgrade or ask at a cost, step or time limit
read any run back step by step from its trace

name: Voice Desk
tagline: design for an interruptible voice support agent
summary: A voice support agent: speech in, tool calls, speech out, and it stops talking the moment the caller interrupts.

highlights.text: streaming speech-to-text, agent and text-to-speech
the caller can interrupt mid-sentence, and the agent remembers only what was heard
a time budget for each stage, measured and published

name: Browser Agent
tagline: design for a browser fallback when an API fails
summary: An agent that finishes a task in a real browser when there is no API, or when the API fails, and reports success only after a separate check has seen evidence.

highlights.text: try the API first, fall back to the browser on error
drive a headless browser from page structure, not screenshots alone
completion judged by evidence, never by the agent itself

name: Cited Answers
tagline: design for document answers with measured retrieval
summary: Question answering over documents where every sentence carries a verified quote, and retrieval and faithfulness are scored on every change.

highlights.text: heading-aware splitting and hybrid search in PostgreSQL
answers whose quotes are checked against the passage in code
recall, faithfulness and refusals gated in CI
